question_cn: 在复杂局面（L2/L3级别）中，引离往往需要多步才能完成。以下哪个思路最准确描述了多步引离组合的逻辑？
question_en: In complex positions, a deflection may take several moves. Which idea best describes a multi-move deflection combination?

options.text_cn: 第一步随便走，等对方出错再抓住机会
options.text_en: Make any move first, then wait for the opponent to blunder

options.text_cn: 先走中间步（Zwischenzug）打乱对方节奏，再在下一步实施引离
options.text_en: Play an intermediate move (Zwischenzug) to disrupt the opponent, then deflect a defender on the next move

options.text_cn: 每步都用将军或赢子威胁剥离一层防守，直到最终目标完全暴露
options.text_en: Use a check or a threat to win material at each step, removing one layer of defense until the final target is exposed

options.text_cn: 兑换所有棋子进入简化残局
options.text_en: Exchange all the pieces to reach a simplified endgame

explanation_cn: 多步引离（连续引离）是高阶应用：如果一个目标有多层保护，则逐步剥离——第一手引离外层守卫，第二手引离内层守卫，直到目标彻底暴露。每一步都必须是强制性的（将军或明确赢子威胁），不给对方重新布防的机会。这是L2/L3局面中最常见的引离组合形式。
explanation_en: A multi-step deflection removes layers of protection one at a time: first deflect an outer defender, then an inner one, until the target is exposed. Each move must be forcing, such as a check or a clear threat to win material, so the opponent has no time to reorganize the defense.
